entries.heading: There is hereby appropriated $1,000,000 to carry out
ancestors: DIVISION A—AGRICULTURE, RURAL DEVELOPMENT, FOOD AND DRUG ADMINISTRATION, AND RELATED AGENCIES APPROPRIATIONS ACT, 2021
entries.text:
Sec. 758.  There is hereby appropriated $1,000,000 to carry out 
section 1671 of the Food, Agriculture, Conservation, and Trade Act of 
1990 (7 U.S.C. 5924) as amended by section 7208 of Public Law 115-334.
